selectionReason: First ten absent Jōyō rows on the B167 receipt.

selectionNotes.廷: 法廷 (news1/ichi1) supports テイ, the only reading in the standard-use table, and 法 has a card. The kana word たいてい (1779160, usually/most) is unrelated to 退廷.
selectionNotes.弊: 弊害 (news1/ichi1) is the first example for ヘイ in the standard-use table; 害 has a card. 幣害 is search-only. 弊社 is mentioned on the card as a humble usage, not as the mapped word.
selectionNotes.弓: The single-kanji word 弓 (news1/ichi1) supports ゆみ; キュウ is shown with 弓道 and not offered. No existing word article is written with 弓.
selectionNotes.弔: 弔問 (news1) is the first example for チョウ in the standard-use table; 問 has a card. 弔う is shown on the card for とむらう.
selectionNotes.弥: Untagged route; see the mapping exceptionReason. 弥々 (1587670) is a rarely used kanji form of いよいよ and 弥る a search-only form of 渡る (1444680); neither is an existing-card reuse.
selectionNotes.弦: 弦楽 (news1) supports ゲン; 楽 has a card. The standard-use examples 上弦 and 正弦 need 上 or 正 and are narrower astronomical or mathematical terms.
selectionNotes.彩: 色彩 (news1/ichi1) is a standard-use example for サイ; 色 has a card, whose reading row already named 色彩 and now links it.
selectionNotes.彰: 表彰 (news1/ichi1) is the first example for ショウ in the standard-use table; 表 has a card. 表賞 is search-only.
selectionNotes.征: 征服 (news1/ichi1) is the first example for セイ in the standard-use table; 服 has a card. 制服 is a homophone with no word article.
selectionNotes.忌: 回忌 (news1) supports キ; 回 has a card. JMdict glosses 三回忌 as the second anniversary of a death, and the word article teaches that count.

supportMappings.exceptionReason: No candidate written with 弥 that carries news1, ichi1, spec1 or gai1 can back a quizzed reading. 弥生 (entry 1537730, news1) has the whole-word reading やよい listed in the appendix of the standard-use table; 阿弥陀 (spec1) needs 阿 and 陀, which have no cards; 弥勒 (1910950) carries only news2 and needs 勒, which has no card; 弥々 (1587670) is a rarely used kanji form of the usually-kana いよいよ, and 弥る is search-only in 渡る (1444680). The untagged route of the issue #60 rule therefore applies, with a row-specific justification. 弥縫策 (entry 1732370) is untagged; its other kanji 縫 and 策 have cards; its spelling and its reading びほうさく carry no irregular, rare, outdated, ateji or gikun mark (the variant reading びぼうさく is marked irregular and is not taught); and it backs the KANJIDIC2 on reading ビ. ビ is outside the standard-use table, which gives 弥 only や with 弥生; the card states this. Digital Daijisen has the heading びほう‐さく【▽弥縫策】. Keep this explicit untagged exception for independent review.
